name: Cone of Cold, Greater
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level magus 6, shaman 7, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 7

This spell functions as cone of cold except the damage maximum is 20d6 cold damage and targets are affected by the slow spell for 2d4 rounds on a failed save or 1 round on a successful one.
